notes.title: 《ALCHEMAGE》Reboot Plan & September 19th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings, Alchemists,
Over the days since we decided to reboot the game, we have been continuously monitoring the various suggestions and feedback on issues raised by players in the community, and we have also defined a new direction for the game's subsequent development work through planning.



Currently, the game has undergone its first maintenance update after the reboot at 14:00 on September 19, 2025! Now, let's first explain the specific update content of this time and our subsequent long-term plans!


① New Content in the Version:

New Enemies Unveiled:
Mini Ghoul、Mini Ghoul、Mini Skeleton、Skeleton King、Mini Archer、Giant Dragon Fish、Giant Hermit Crab、Giant Hawk、Giant Frog

New Equipment and Items:
S-Emerald Staff、S-Ruby Staff、S-Spapphire Staff、S-Topaz Staff、Life Branch、Bone Sword、Rotten Dried Fish、Sticky Sweep Net、Amethyst  Staff

Brand-New Launch of Editor Function: Resolved the long-standing issue where maps created with the Map Editor could not be played normally
(Currently, only the placement and play of blocks, walls, and plant-related content are supported. We are still continuously optimizing and fixing the remaining parts, and Steam Workshop will also be supported in the future)
② Version Fixes:
Map Editor: No play entry for created maps

Map Editor: Unable to exit the editor page normally after saving a map

Map Editor: Unable to delete background wall grids

Map Editor: Mouse position offset during placement

Fixed the issue where the game display was incomplete at some resolutions

③ Game Optimizations:
Added descriptive texts for some items

Optimized the overall UI style of the Map Editor and localized it into Simplified Chinese

Adjusted the function descriptions of some plants to help everyone understand the characteristics of each plant

Adjusted the function descriptions of some Rune Tablets and Furniture to facilitate everyone's construction and map editing

Map Editor: No success prompt when saving a map

Removed the game launcher and transferred all its functions to the in-game settings





If you, esteemed Warlocks, encounter any BUGs while playing the game, or have opinions and suggestions regarding the game's subsequent gameplay content and optimization adjustments, you are more than welcome to provide us with feedback in the comment section of this post or on relevant social media platforms~




Official Game QQ Group: 1055211096
Discord: 

https://discord.gg/npCK2nt7




Official Email: lzyj2025@126.com





Overview of the Game's Subsequent Plans ↓
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30500679/40228a4e0a3c17295108f555143ebe0ccee86a68.png"]Fix Version (September ~ Mid-to-Early October):
 We will prioritize improving the user experience of the Map Editor and continuously fix and optimize the existing issues of the game;

Workshop Version (Late October ~ Early November): 
We will give priority to promoting the integration and interconnection of the Steam Workshop function, making it convenient for esteemed Warlocks to share the creative maps they have made; at the same time, we will also continue to advance the launch of the domestic PC version to facilitate the gaming experience for domestic Warlock friends;

Brand-New Gameplay (Late November ~ Long-Term Updates):
 We are considering adding a brand-new gameplay experience to the game. Currently, the preliminary plan focuses on increasing the survival difficulty and customizing the starting character for challenge progression. At the same time, we will also actively adopt everyone's opinions to further improve the game content;

Mobile Version (Q1 2026 ~ Q2 2026): 
During this stage, we will first prioritize improving the basic porting content of the mobile version and arrange a new mobile test for the rebooted version. We also want to let the friends who have been waiting for the mobile version experience it as soon as possible; however, due to the need for certain optimizations and fixes for related porting bugs, the official release of the mobile version will be a little later. Nevertheless, we will strive to launch it and meet everyone as soon as possible!

More Plans (Ongoing): 
For new creature content and home decoration items, we will add them in a timely manner according to the version schedule. We also welcome esteemed Warlocks to leave messages and provide suggestions, and we will actively adopt some of the new setting content you provide; the adaptation for more devices such as game consoles will be carried out after the mobile version, and we will gradually present it to everyone after the game is fully improved to our satisfaction.

notes.title: 0.12.0 Update
notes.content:
Including content updated in version 0.11.0 at December 5th, 2018

In 0.12.2
 Many Multiplayer bugs fixed. 

 In 0.12.1
 Alpaca kept in a  [Stable] will slowly recover its HP
 This update may cause some mud walls to be undiggable. You can use command "wall.erase" to clear out the wall.

 New block [Fortress Stone Block].
 New block [Savanna Leaf Block].
 New block [Savanna Wood Block].
 New wall [Savanna Wood Wall].
 New wall [Fortress Stone Wall].
 New wall [Fortress Pillar Wall].
 New plant [Apple Tree].
 New plant [Pumpkin].
 New placement [Fortress Torch].
 New placement [Fortress Stair].
 New placement [Armor Stand]. You can put your armor and cloth on it
 New placement [Wooden Cabinet].
 New placement [Painting].
 New placement [Pot].
 New placement [Well].
 New placement [Street Lamp].
 New Equipment [Straw Hat].

 Visual FX improvement for magic [Spiky Rock] and [Summon Undead].
 New weather system with rain and snow.
 Console commands have been tweaked. Check the thread "Some Usefull Console Commands" at Discussion for new commands.
 Now you can plant sapling in flower pot.
 Network connection stability slightly improved.
 Now you can customize your character's hair color when creating new character.
 Add player chat bubble.
 [Wooden Fence] is moved to wall layer and has a new look.
 It is now possible to place transparent walls like [Glass Wall] underground.
 Add several predefined structures like a deserted village and ancient ruins in map generation.

 Bug Fixed: Sometimes your alpaca kept in a [Stable] get lost.


 As the chance for a rain to come is low, if you are very eager to see it, use command "event.start 500103" to summon a rain.
 This update may cause placements as [Crating Table], [Furnace], [Alchemy Table] firstly created at an old version be lost. You may need to craft them again.
 If there is an empty tile on which you can not place any other tile, point your mouse cursor at it and type in command "tile.erase" at Console to clear it.


ABOUT WHY THIS TIME TOOK SO LONG
Actually, the development for this game has already been suspended and our team has been assigned other tasks to do, mainly to assist in the development of other projects by our publisher. We are still able to work on Alchemage, but we can only do this during the breaks of our assigned jobs, for the last couple of months. That means later update period for Alchemage is uncertain. It is sad that it turned out like this after so many efforts we put into this game, but we are not yet giving up on it.

notes.title: 0.10.0 Update
notes.content:
New placement [Bookshelf]. You can put a book or a scroll in it.
New placement [Barn Door]. It is a biggerl door so that alpacas can pass by.
New placement [Wooden Stool].
New placement [Enchantment Table].
New placement [Sign]. You can write text on it.
New placement [Recharge Stone]. A replacement for previous rune stones to provide limited amount of magic energy from time to time.
New item [Magic Book], a way to share magic with your friend. Can be made by putting an empty book and a magic into [Enchantment Table].
New item [Magic Scroll]. You can store your magic energy into it. Can be made by putting an empty scroll and a magic into [Enchantment Table].
Quest System added along with 5 initial quests, replacing the old tasks.

Rune stones no longer drop theirselves when digged. Instead, they drop [Rune Stone Fragment], with which you can make other magic devices at [Crafting Table].
The function for resetting respawn point has been moved from [Bed] to [Stone of Recall], which can now be crafted at [Crafting Table].

Add an option to turn on cursor lock when digging.
Player character will automatically switch to another proper equipment from inventory when current one runs out of durability and breaks
The moon now will change in phase.
Text rendering improved.
Wraith now has a skill to summon skeletons. When killed, Wraith will drop a magic book that records its skill at low change.

notes.title: 0.8.0 Update: Alchemy System Improved

New placement [Bathtub]

New equipment [Frog Suit], [Frog Hood]. Together they help you jump higher and keep you from being attacked by jungle frogs

notes.title: 0.6.0 Updata : Magic Missions and Upgrades
notes.content:
Lava, can be found deep underground. You can carry lava with a [Bucket] and be very careful dealing with it. In case you catch fire, you can cool yourself down with water.
New block [Obsidian Block], formed when lava meets water.
Better tile and grass rendering ( Looks better with lower performance cost)
The Mountain Biome now has it own background.
You can make you character run by double click and hold moving keys.
New creature [Ice Slime]. Can be found at Mountain Biome.
New creature [Lava Slime].

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500679/fd64955cd6a312cb0932d72e62e7faf725801712.png

Some magic VFX improvement.
Magic Missions and Upgrades. You can recharge or upgrade you magic after you completing some missions. You can check for these informations at the magic menu ( Turned on by press the Magic Book icon below the inventory or by press the shortcut key which in default is N).
Some alchemy products are now used in magic recharging.
You can no longer throw out a magic item or place it into any containers like chests. If you discard a magic item from your inventory, you can take it back at any time from the magic menu.
Spells. Some magic require you to input a specific spell in order to use or recharge. Press [ENTER] key to turn on the spell input area and press [ENTER] again to commit after you finishing input. You can check for those spells at the magic item description or the magic menu.

Note that world saves created before version 0.4.0 (2.9.2018) are no longer supported.

notes.title: 0.3.0 Update with Steam Multiplayer!
notes.content:
- Finally Steam Multiplayer is brought to this game. You and your friends no longer need to be in the same LAN to play together. Connections can be made directly via Steam.

- HOW TO START A SERVER:
Start a game as usual, and at the in-game ESC Menu, turn on [Allow Others to Join]. Then you friend can join your game via the Steam Friend List, or by the Steam Lobby ID.

- HOW TO JOIN A GAME:
Select [Join Game] on the main menu, select your character and then click [Join by Steam Lobby ID], input the ID your friend tell you and click [Connect]. If you are invited to a game or use the Steam Friend List to join a game, the ID will be filled in automatically.

- We optimized the game for some bit to spare some performance for networking. So if you play as single player. It may save up to about 15% of CPU performance.

- We also remade the ESC Menu and put game options and control setting in it so that they can be tweaked directly when gameplay is going on. In single player mode, turning on the ESC Menu will pause the game.

- Add Tree Exposion FX

- Now water flows will wash placed torches away.

- Bug Fixed: Some creatures would be generated in your home.

- Bug Fixed: Some items in Inventory became Grass Block

notes.title: 0.2.0 Update
notes.content:
Game came to version 0.2. We will establish the basic systems not done before in version 0.2.
Compared to version 0.1, version 0.2 will make the following changes:

1. Magic collection system.You can use a more interesting way to produce the spell rather than just picked up from the box.
2. Element attribute system.Many equipment can enhance element attributes of the characters, thus enhance the effect of corresponding spell.Different monster also have different weak element attributes, targeted attacks can get twice the result with half the effort.
3. Temperature system.Long-term use of fire spells will make your body overheating and burning, and the long-term use of ice spells will take you frozen!Enemy, of course, also under the same temperature influence, how to use the temperature system fight?It's up to you.
4. Furnace system changed.More items can be fuel in the furnace ,but different fuels provide temperature is different. Some fuels can't smelting metal because of not reaching a certain temperature, and some of the material is high temperature smelting will burn into ashes.How to get the products they want?Try by yourself.
5. Alchemy system changes.Alchemy is not, of course,only used to create  spells , alchemy can produce numerous magical potions, bombs, powder. Use them to challenge the powerful opponent would help you a lot.


Above is for 0.2, we will be completed after the completion of the test with a few small version update, below is the updated 0.2.0


Add :
- A total new UI
- Item split: CTRL can be used to split items
- Quickly spread content: Shift can be used to quickly spread
- Change the furnace system: you need to consider the temperature of the fuel from now on.
- Increased the runestone system, the arrangement of the various mysterious world runestone recording the mantra of unknown civilization
- Adds a series of new items

Next:
- Spell collection system
- Element level system
- Temperature system


Ps: Everyone is thirsty of the online content,and we have been working on it. You will be able to play with your steam friends online and access to cloud archiving in version 0.3 , and 0.3.0 will be completed in late November. Thank you for reading .

5. Alchemy system changes.Alchemy is not, of course,only used to create  spells , alchemy can produce numerous magical potions, bombs, powder. Use them to challenge the powerful opponent would help you a lot.


Above is for 0.2, we will be completed after the completion of the test with a few small version update, below is the updated 0.2.0


Add :
- A total new UI
- Item split: CTRL can be used to split items
- Quickly spread content: Shift can be used to quickly spread
- Change the furnace system: you need to consider the temperature of the fuel from now on.
- Increased the runestone system, the arrangement of the various mysterious world runestone recording the mantra of unknown civilization
- Adds a series of new items

Next:
- Spell collection system
- Element level system
- Temperature system


Ps: Everyone is thirsty of the online content,and we have been working on it. You will be able to play with your steam friends online and access to cloud archiving in version 0.3 , and 0.3.0 will be completed in late November. Thank you for reading .

- In low-resolution , UI is too small
- Change attribute of monsters , they are stronger now

  Common mode: objects in the backpack will drop after death

- Let the world have more treasure chest, more reasonable ecology

Finally, we will try our best to solve the problem of some players breaking down in the game. To prepare for the next major release, the daily small version is more likely to be paused (unless for serious bugs).
